verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for self-hosted Git server software, but the evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any switch to disable them. The self-hosting claim ("Full control") and generic app.ini/admin-panel configuration are adjacent controls, not a documented telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
